name: [[672,14,56]] weight-8 two-block group-algebra code on C12:C28(r=11)

provenance.construction: Two-block group-algebra code (Lin and Pryadko, arXiv:2306.16400) on G = C12:C28(r=11) of order 336, Cayley table research/kit/group_algebra.metacyclic(12, 28, 11) with the identity at index 0 and elements indexed as that builder lists them: H_X = [L(a) | R(b)], H_Z = [R(b)^T | L(a)^T] with L(g)[g h, h] = 1 and R(g)[h g, h] = 1 (research/kit/group_algebra.py build_2bga(mul, a, b)); a = [0, 183, 208, 303], b = [0, 89, 225, 310] (element indices). n = 2|G| = 672, check weight 8.
provenance.notes: Found by the fourth LER-objective search (two-block group-algebra codes over non-abelian groups with check weight 6, 7, or 8 at 420 < n <= 700 and k >= 8): circuit-level logical error rate at 3 rounds under the board's depolarizing recipe, interleaved schedule, decoded with CUDA-Q QEC nv-qldpc-decoder (BP+OSD-CS order 10). At p = 0.002, 100000 shots per basis: Z memory 1 failures, X memory 0 failures, against 14 copies of the distance-7 rotated surface code (1358 physical qubits, same builder and decoder) with 43 and 58 failures. Decoder-based d_circ estimate at 3 rounds: 56. Distance: RIS at 20,000 trials (gf2_fast) and a 300,000,000-trial verify/ris_gpu.py pass per side; upper bounds. Details in the accompanying note.
